audit.why: Karma wins levels 1-4 on Mantra-Q poke and Focused Resolve tether; Galio takes over at 6 with the uncancelable Hero's Entrance engage.
Level 6 R (Hero's Entrance) and first item MR are the two spikes that flip the lane; both already stated in content.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-6].side all read the generic enum "Skill" instead of naming who wins each row, contradicting content win[N] (Karma rows 0-3, Galio rows 4-6) and the packet levelChart. phases[N].why text also argued the wrong side for several rows (e.g. phases[0].why described Galio zoning a formation during a level Karma actually wins).
audit.why: The level chart must agree with the content layer or the page shows two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.corrected: phases[0-3].side -> Karma, phases[4-6].side -> Galio, matching win[N] and packet.levelChart; why text rewritten per row to match.

edits.before: Q the pair — the tornado tick chips duos that stand in formation.
edits.after: Empowered Q roots and bursts you before E reaches range — farm it.

edits.before: W charge threat begins: the taunt governs their engage plans already.
edits.after: Her Q still outranges your engage — poke chips you before W matters.

edits.before: Full kit: E-W the committed trade and the magic shield refunds their poke.
edits.after: Full kit: Focused Resolve tether and Mantra shield keep her ahead in trades.

edits.before: Zone with taunt threat and shield the margins — AP duos pay double rent.
edits.after: Her poke lead peaks at 4-5 while you're still farming toward level 6.

edits.before: Hero's Entrance online — every roam your duo survives, you end.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is uncancelable engage that erases her range edge.

edits.before: First item: the taunt rotation chunks and the MR makes mage supports cry.
edits.after: First item: your MR blunts Mantra-Q, so her poke stops paying off.

edits.before: Late Galio is the anti-dive: taunt their engage off your carry and R the map's emergencies.
edits.after: Two items and durability outscale her — she has no hard CC to stop your R+E all-in dive.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Shield of Durand answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): 12s cooldown, matchup-defining — break the root with range or line of sight before every duo step-up. - Your W Shield of Durand (18-14s) answers one disaster per cooldown. - R is 180-140s: spend it only on swing moments.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Once her 12s W tether and Mantra Q are both down, E-W into the carry — she has no answer for that window.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: A warded bush means her tether lands before your taunt does — you eat the root and she disengages clean.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Commit on Focused Resolve (Tether)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Focused Resolve (Tether)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.
